name: Bay Leaves
siboNotes: Bay leaves are naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated by most SIBO patients when used in typical cooking amounts.
preparationTips: Remove whole leaves before serving as they remain tough and inedible
Add to soups, stews, and braises at the beginning of cooking
Crush slightly to release more flavor compounds
Store in airtight container away from light to preserve potency
nutritionalHighlights: Provides small amounts of vitamin A
Contains essential oils with anti-inflammatory properties
